description: Lateral slide leftward of the whole composition: first tree/leaf scene exits left while a second tree composition with locust-like insects enters from the right edge (f7420-7423) and settles; hard cut vs slide cannot be told from 8 tiles.

Text '13th cent...' reveals left to right from f8028 to f8033 beside the character; wipe-like, exact mechanism UNAVAILABLE.
Character slides left and slightly down from x~190 to ~100 tile px between f8026 and f8031 then holds.
White/pale background transitions to blue sky and sand across f8088-8092; character stays at left.
Genghis on mount drifts slightly with label static; small settle only.
Figure and label slide off to the left with accelerating motion from f8428 to f8432; f8433 tile blank white.
No change visible in the 8 tiles beyond sub-pixel drift of board; low peak 1.63 is likely texture/pointer jitter (INFERRED).
Genghis on mount and left riders shift position slightly with head bob while the scene slowly enlarges.
Riders at left and Genghis shift a few tile px and Genghis head tilts; corpses do not move.
